{{Short description|German chemist (born 1944)}}
[[File:Seppelt, Konrad.jpg|thumb|Konrad Seppelt (2018)]]
'''Konrad Seppelt''' (born September 2, 1944 in Leipzig)<ref>{{cite journal |title=The Robert A. Welch Foundation Research Bulletin |issue=51 |year=1988 |page=26}}</ref> is an academic, author, professor and former vice president of the [[Free University of Berlin]].

==Publications==
===Popular publications===
* [http://www.timeshighereducation.co.uk/story.asp?storyCode=154984&sectioncode=26 Cutting Edge], Konrad Seppelt, The (London) [[Times Higher Education]] Supplement, November 10, 2000, p.&nbsp;24.
* [http://www3.interscience.wiley.com/cgi-bin/fulltext/109087592/PDFSTART The Future of Chemistry ... ]{{dead link|date=January 2025|bot=medic}}{{cbignore|bot=medic}}, Editorial, Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2004, 43, 3618 –3620
* Science, [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/27516596 Isolation and structural and electronic characterization of salts of the decamethylferrocene dication.] August 2016 12;353(6300):678-82
* Science, [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/11021792 Xenon as a complex ligand: the tetra xenono Gold(II) cation in AuXe<sub>4</sub><sup>2+</sup>(Sb<sub>2</sub>F<sub>11</sub><sup>−</sup>)<sub>2</sub>.  2000 Oct 6;290(5489)]:117-8.
* Science, [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/17791392 Response: Structure of W(CH<sub>3</sub>)<sub>6</sub>. 1996 Apr 12;272(5259):182b-3b.]
